facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: This story is about Anne of Green Gables. The theme today is imagination. A vivid imagination is truly a gift. Let us read more!
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Today we continue Anne of Green Gables. The main theme is about imagination. The characters face an important moment. A vivid imagination is truly a gift. This sentence shows what happens in the story. Think about why this matters.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: In this part of Anne of Green Gables, we explore the idea of imagination. The characters must deal with a difficult situation.
